card.name: In vitro enzyme inhibition statements
card.fires_on: Words ending a phrase about inhibiting enzymes or transporters, such as 'at' before 'clinically relevant concentrations', or 'receptors' after dopamine D2. Found in drug interaction text on in vitro findings.

modes.label: Concentration phrase
modes.description: The word 'at' (or 'of') right after an enzyme or transporter inhibition claim, leading into concentrations.
modes.example: In vitro data suggest that vardenafil has the potential to inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp)<< at>> therapeutic doses.

modes.label: Inhibition or receptor wording
modes.description: Words like 'inhibition', 'inhibitory' or 'receptors' in statements about enzyme inhibition or dopamine antagonism.
